correctness.rationale: PASS: Boundary phase derivative P(θ)=q+Σ(1-a_j²)/(1+a_j²−2a_j cos θ) is even and strictly monotone over (0,π), so every autocorrelation phase F_t(θ)=φ(θ+t)−φ(θ) has precisely two stationary points −t/2, π−t/2. They are nondegenerate for 0<t≤π, with |F_t|=U t+O(t³), V t+O(t³) as t→0. Exact autocorrelation identity A_n(t)=Σ|c_{n,k}|²e^{ikt} and Parseval reduce Σ|c|⁴ to an integral of |A_n|². Uniform stationary phase for nt≥K yields two diagonal 1/(nt) endpoint terms and their log n coefficient; the phase-difference derivative P(t/2)−P(π+t/2)>0 makes interference O(1/n); short t and interior contribute O_B(1/n). Monomial z^q merely shifts coefficients. Independent exact endpoint-curvature constants and finite coefficient/Parseval checks corroborate, but cannot certify infinite n.
